info.title: Wellisha Commerce API
info.description: Implemented commerce foundation. Cognito access tokens require the configured issuer/client_id; no legacy cookie authentication. JSON bodies are limited to 16384 bytes; compressed bodies are rejected. Catalog list returns a page envelope. Four simple non-stacking same-SKU offer types share one evaluator with owned carts and order lines. Percentage discounts round down per unit before multiplying quantity. Visible clients refetch within 15 seconds or sooner at schedule boundaries. Buy-X-get-Y quantities include free units. Cart totals are not checkout quotes. Pricing administration requires wellisha/pricing.write scope AND a server-owned catalog.pricing.write permission. Checkout remains disabled by default until provider/reservation/quote acceptance. TypeScript consumers reject unsafe integer money.

get.description: Resolves authenticated issuer/subject to a customer. Creates mapping on first access.
Latest 100 owned addresses, newest first. No pagination parameters yet.

patch.description: Full replacement with optimistic version check. Stale versions return ownership-safe 404.

get.description: Paged active sellable SKUs with API-calculated prices. Sort by effective single-unit price. Each SKU is a pack/variant in this first slice. Offset pages may shift during catalog edits; quotes revalidate prices before checkout.

post.description: Accept the owned, unexpired quote without repricing. Returns 409 on changed price/address/stock; create and review a fresh quote. CHECKOUT_ENABLED remains a deployment gate.

503.description: Checkout disabled: empty body. Transient database failure: ApiError. Clients must handle both.

get.description: Latest 100 owned orders, newest first. No pagination parameters yet.
Saved shipments for an owned order. Empty before booking. Nullable delivery estimate; never implies pickup or guaranteed delivery.
Latest 100 owned in-app messages, newest first. External delivery workers are not implemented.

patch.description: Idempotently marks an owned message read; no request body.

get.description: Active categories ordered by sort order and ID.

patch.description: Requires wellisha/pricing.write Cognito scope AND server-owned catalog.pricing.write permission for issuer/subject. Replaces base price and complete offer schedule using expected version. No overlapping offers, no stacking, all four rule types same SKU only. Audit committed atomically. Missing/stale product version returns 409. Staff MFA remains a production configuration gate.

get.description: Reads base price, current version and full current schedule including future offers. Requires the same scope and server-owned permission as pricing writes.
Owned cart, repriced on every read. No stock reservation or payment commitment. Server returns exact line totals and savings. No coupon stacking.

post.description: Adds quantity to the owned SKU line, maximum 100 per line and 50 distinct lines. Checks stock; does not reserve it.

cognitoAccessToken.description: Cognito access token from configured user pool and app client.

value.description: PERCENTAGE: basis points (1500=15%); FIXED_AMOUNT: discount per unit in minor units; BUNDLE_PRICE: total for buyQuantity units; BUY_X_GET_Y: zero. See pricing rules for kind-specific limits.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed JSON, missing required input or invalid field.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing or invalid Cognito access token. Body is not guaranteed.

Forbidden.description: Access denied. Body is not guaranteed.

NotFound.description: Resource absent, belongs to another customer, or address version is stale.

Conflict.description: Stock/state conflict, changed idempotent payload or database constraint.

TooLarge.description: Body exceeds 16384 bytes, including streamed requests.

UnsupportedMedia.description: Unsupported media type or Content-Encoding other than identity.

InternalError.description: Safe internal error; no exception details.
